Jedi Tests posted as 'Jedi test 1'–'Jedi test 6'; dested by number to Great Warrior, A Jedi's Strength, Domain Of Evil, Size Matters Not, It Is The Future You See, You Must Confront Vader. The 'Jedi Tests (6)' section header was dropped.
Posted 'Artoo in Red 5 x2 [7]' dested Artoo-Detoo In Red 5 x2 (Third Anthology; destiny 0 or 7, matching the [7]). 'Star destroyer [7]' dested Star Destroyer! (destiny 7).

Posted 'Epp luke', 'Epp han', 'epp Obi-wan', 'Ecc chewie' and 'Ecc Lando' dested the Enhanced characters Luke With Lightsaber, Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol, Obi-Wan With Lightsaber, Chewie With Blaster Rifle and Lando With Blaster Pistol.

Posted 'Dagobah Yoda's hutt' dested Dagobah: Yoda's Hut; 'OOC/TT' the Light combo Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated; 'It could be worce' It Could Be Worse; 'Anger, Fear Aggression' Anger, Fear, Aggression.
Wise Advice was an Effect in 2001 (not a Defensive Shield).
